page: Microsoft Azure DC96eds_v6 is an x86_64 compute instance hosted on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware profile features dedicated Intel processor allocation with 96 vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. The server does not incorporate graphics processing units, centering compute allocation strictly on CPU and system memory operations.

Storage capabilities include 5,669 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity, offering direct low-latency disk input and output for operations requiring substantial temporary throughput. In addition to onboard NVMe media, the instance is compatible with Azure Premium Storage for decoupled disk provisioning. Network provisioning does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With 96 dedicated physical CPU execution threads and expansive onboard NVMe storage, resource efficiency is concentrated in monolithic capacity on a single node without external network disk bottlenecks. The DC96eds_v6 is structured for large relational or NoSQL database deployments, extensive extract-transform-load data pipelines, complex compilation environments, and scalable enterprise application backends.
description: Microsoft Azure DC96eds_v6 is an x86_64 compute instance designed for intensive computational and I/O tasks on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 96 dedicated Intel vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of system memory per vCPU. Local storage is provided through a 5,669 GB NVMe SSD array, complemented by Premium Storage compatibility for external attached volumes. The instance does not feature graphics acceleration hardware or bundled public IPv4 networking. Delivering high core density alongside extensive local solid-state storage, the DC96eds_v6 operates efficiently for heavy operational demands without external storage dependency. This configuration fits high-concurrency databases, large-scale ETL data processing, continuous integration build clusters, and high-traffic enterprise application serving.
